title: Advanced Discourse Devices
subtitle: Discourse devices connect ideas across sentences and paragraphs, guiding the reader through an argument. At C2, these go well beyond "however" and "therefore."
objectives: Understand and use: Formal sentence-level connectors
Understand and use: Discourse markers structuring formal writing
Understand and use: Cohesive devices across paragraphs — devices that create flow at a larger scale:

content.intro: Discourse devices connect ideas across sentences and paragraphs, guiding the reader through an argument. At C2, these go well beyond "however" and "therefore."

rules.heading: a) Formal sentence-level connectors
rules.body:
• notwithstanding (= despite, often placed after the noun it refers to, or at the start of a clause): The plan, criticism notwithstanding, went ahead. / Notwithstanding the criticism, the plan went ahead.
  • nevertheless / nonetheless (= despite what was just said): The evidence was weak. Nevertheless, the jury convicted him.
  • moreover / furthermore (= adding a stronger supporting point): The policy is expensive. Moreover, it has proven ineffective.
  • on which point / in this connection / to this end (= referring back to something just mentioned, moving the argument forward): The report calls for reform. On which point, several committee members disagreed.

rules.heading: b) Discourse markers structuring formal writing
rules.body:
• that said / that having been said (= acknowledging a point before pivoting)
  • insofar as (= to the extent that): The plan is sound, insofar as it addresses short-term needs.
  • by the same token (= applying the same logic to a related point)
  • conversely (= introducing a contrasting point using parallel logic)

rules.heading: c) Cohesive devices across paragraphs — devices that create flow at a larger scale:
rules.body:
• Resumptive/summative nouns referring back to a previous idea: this trend, such measures, this development, the aforementioned issue.
  • Signposting phrases that guide the reader through an argument's structure: it is worth noting that, this raises the question of, having established X, it follows that Y.

examples: The proposal, controversy notwithstanding, was approved by a narrow margin.
The results were inconclusive. Nevertheless, the researchers pressed ahead with further trials.
The scheme is costly. Moreover, it fails to address the root cause of the problem.
The policy succeeded insofar as it reduced emissions, though it did little to boost the economy.
That said, not every critic dismissed the plan outright.
Conversely, smaller firms benefited significantly from the same regulation.
Such measures, however well-intentioned, often produce unintended consequences.
This development raises important questions about the future of the industry.
By the same token, if we accept this argument, we must also accept its implications.
It is worth noting that the study's sample size was relatively small.

commonMistakes.wrong: Notwithstanding of the criticism, they proceeded.
commonMistakes.why: "Notwithstanding" is followed directly by a noun phrase — no preposition ("of") is needed.

commonMistakes.wrong: The evidence was weak, nevertheless the jury convicted him.
commonMistakes.right: The evidence was weak. Nevertheless, the jury convicted him. (or with a semicolon: ...weak; nevertheless, the jury convicted him.)
commonMistakes.why: "Nevertheless" is a discourse adverb, not a coordinating conjunction — it needs a full stop or semicolon before it, and typically a comma after.

commonMistakes.wrong: The plan worked insofar it addressed the budget.
commonMistakes.right: The plan worked insofar as it addressed the budget.
commonMistakes.why: The full connector is "insofar as," never "insofar" alone.

commonMistakes.wrong: Moreover of the cost, the plan was poorly timed.
commonMistakes.right: Moreover, the plan was poorly timed. (as a separate point) — or: In addition to the cost, the plan was poorly timed.
commonMistakes.why: "Moreover" doesn't take an object with "of" — it introduces a new independent point, not a phrase.

commonMistakes.wrong: By the same token, however, we should also consider...
commonMistakes.right: By the same token, we should also consider... (choose one connector; don't stack contrasting ones)
commonMistakes.why: "By the same token" extends the same logic; pairing it with "however" (which signals contrast) sends a contradictory signal.

content.registerNote: notwithstanding, insofar as, and on which point belong to formal academic/legal writing; nevertheless and moreover are common in both formal writing and careful speech.

exercises.title: Rewrite / Transformation
exercises.instructions: Rewrite / Transformation (combine the two sentences using the connector indicated)

items.prompt: The theory is elegant. It lacks solid evidence. (use "nevertheless")
answer: The theory is elegant; nevertheless, it lacks solid evidence.
items.explanation: Compare your sentence to the model above once you submit.

items.prompt: Costs are high. The project is behind schedule. (use "moreover")
answer: Costs are high. Moreover, the project is behind schedule.
items.explanation: Compare your sentence to the model above once you submit.

items.prompt: There was strong opposition. The bill passed. (use "notwithstanding," starting the sentence with it)
answer: Notwithstanding strong opposition, the bill passed.
items.explanation: Compare your sentence to the model above once you submit.

items.prompt: The policy reduced unemployment. It only did so in urban areas. (use "insofar as")
answer: The policy reduced unemployment insofar as it did so in urban areas.
items.explanation: Compare your sentence to the model above once you submit.

items.prompt: Large firms struggled with the new tax. Small firms actually benefited. (use "conversely")
answer: Large firms struggled with the new tax. Conversely, small firms actually benefited.
items.explanation: Compare your sentence to the model above once you submit.

items.incorrect: Notwithstanding of the delays, the project finished on time.
answer: Notwithstanding the delays, the project finished on time.
items.explanation: Check the rule above for this structure.

items.incorrect: The plan is flawed, nevertheless we should still consider it.
answer: The plan is flawed; nevertheless, we should still consider it.
items.explanation: Check the rule above for this structure.

items.incorrect: It worked insofar it met the short-term goal.
answer: It worked insofar as it met the short-term goal.
items.explanation: Check the rule above for this structure.

items.incorrect: Moreover of these issues, there is the question of cost.
answer: In addition to these issues, there is the question of cost.
Moreover, there is the question of cost.
items.explanation: Check the rule above for this structure.

items.incorrect: That said however, the results were still impressive.
answer: That said, the results were still impressive. (remove "however")
items.explanation: Check the rule above for this structure.

items.incorrect: By the same token but, we must reconsider the whole approach.
answer: By the same token, we must reconsider the whole approach. (remove "but")
items.explanation: Check the rule above for this structure.

exercises.title: Guided Production
exercises.instructions: Write your own sentence. There's no single correct answer — a model answer is shown for comparison after you submit.

items.prompt: Write one sentence using "notwithstanding" in formal register about a decision or event.
items.modelAnswer: Notwithstanding the initial backlash, the reform ultimately proved popular with voters.

items.prompt: Write one sentence using "insofar as" to qualify a claim.
items.modelAnswer: The new policy succeeded insofar as it reduced costs, though it did little to improve service quality.

items.prompt: Write two connected sentences using "Moreover" to add a supporting point to an argument.
items.modelAnswer: The current system is outdated. Moreover, it is far more expensive to maintain than any proposed alternative.

items.prompt: Write one sentence using "that said" to pivot after acknowledging a counterpoint.
items.modelAnswer: That said, I still think the plan deserves a fair trial before we abandon it entirely.
